messages:
maya: Heads-up — scheduling a maintenance window on ap-sg1 (pool-gamma) tomorrow 02:00–03:30 UTC. Rolling node drains + GPU firmware reflash. Expect reduced GPU capacity and some request routing.

eric: ETA on capacity hit? Any SLA exposure for Hosted API or Dedicated pools?

maya: Worst-case impact ~20–30% capacity drop in pool-gamma for ~90m while cohorts are drained and flashed. Hosted API will route realtime to ap-northeast1/us-west2 by policy; Dedicated customers pinned to pool-gamma will see slower queueing or short failures if they have strict placement. We will enable graceful fallback for pinned tenants for the window.

kyle: Suggest we open a soft cap on new job admissions before draining to prevent queue pile-up. Also recommend increasing batch timeout to 600ms for the window to keep throughput.

alex: Network note — NIC flash includes microcode bump that risks brief egress bumpiness (30s) per rack. We'll stagger racks 5m apart to avoid concurrent egress spikes.

maya: Plan outline:
- 01:30 UTC preflight: warn customers via status page and set routing policy to prefer other regions
- 02:00 cohort-A cordon/drain (20 nodes)
- 02:20 firmware flash + reboot (per-node ~3m)
- 03:00 cohort-B cordon/drain (backfill from other regions)
- 03:20 final validation & capacity warmup
- 03:30 window close

maya: Runbook snippet for drain (internal):
```
# drain command (use --grace 300 to preserve in-flight KV cache)
rctl drain --pool pool-gamma --cohort $COHORT --grace 300 --evict-priority low
```

eric: Will Deploy-bot create the maintenance ticket and link runbook?

deploy-bot: Maintenance INFRA-2341 created. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/infrarun/INFRA-2341. Pager on-call @eric. :white_check_mark:

yvonne: I'll draft a short customer comms blurb for Hosted + Dedicated: call out limited routing, expected duration, and contact. Prefer we include a note about potential increased tail latency for embedding calls.

kyle: Cost note — if we push traffic cross-region we'll see additional GPU-on-demand bursts. Ballpark extra spend ~ $2.2k for the window unless we pull from reserved pools. Recommend enabling temporary reserved backfill from gradient-pool if possible.

maya: Good call. I'll request reserved backfill. Also @alex please sequence NIC microcode across racks to avoid >2 concurrent reboots.

alex: Ack. I'll use a 5m cadence and post progress here. I'll also run a quick egress perf test after each rack.

eric: I'll update SLO watch and set an alert if queue depth > 120% or API error rate > 0.5% during window.

maya: Thanks everyone. Will post final timeline + kickoff 30m before 01:30 UTC. Stick to runbook timings. :hammer_and_wrench:
